name: R19 Circular Shield of the Sun

system.description:
You always have [Cancel (Poison, Mental): 30]. [Trigger: Immediately After Damage] Use when you are attacked. The character that attacked you takes [Dazed] after that Main Process ends. Once per scene. However, if that character has [Weakness (Radiance)], this does not use up a use, and it can be used even if its uses are spent. Solar Shield A round shield adorned with the design of the sun. It stores the power of the sun within, granting strong resistance against corrupting evils that devour the body. Additionally, by chanting a command word, it emits a blinding light. Those who are caught in the flash will lose their vision and be left in a daze.

Sun Ornamental Stud [Core Material] (620G) + Knight Shield (740G) + Radiance Talisman (620G) + [Magic Catalyst 19] (340G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (1560G)
